title: LAG and LEAD
description: For each employee, show their salary alongside the previous employee's salary (by hire date) and the next employee's salary. Also show the difference from the previous salary.
hints: LAG(salary) OVER (ORDER BY hire_date) gets previous row's salary
LEAD(salary) OVER (ORDER BY hire_date) gets next row's salary
LAG(salary, 1, 0) uses 0 as default when there's no previous row
